content: We need count of aromatic carbons in the molecule. But we don't have the molecule given. Possibly the system expects we retrieve NMR data to infer aromatic carbons? Could be we need to get carbon NMR spectra and count aromatic signals. But we need the molecule structure. No SMILES provided. Maybe the sample is preloaded; carbon_nmr_spectra returns spectra for "sample at hand". We can call it correctly without arguments? The function signature expects no parameters? It defined carbon_nmr_spectra = (_: {}) => any. So we should call with empty object. I passed {"": {}} incorrectly. Should pass {}.
